newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit easy, but in range on strong dlr, covering.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit easy, but in range on strong dlr, covering.

text.p: The ringgit eased slightly in late afternoon Asian trading on covering of short dollar positions, dealers said on Friday.
They said strong dollar/majors and inability of ringgit bulls to push below 2.4690 had prompted the retreat.
"It is possible that dollar/ringgit will go beyond 2.48 in London time tonight. There are stops likely to be triggered at 2.4810," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
He said there were rumours of a major dollar sell order from some overseas funds around 2.4795, which could cap the U.S. unit's rise for the moment
Some dealers said the ringgit's slide could extend to 2.49 level in a technical correction before the next rally.
The ringgit was also unlikely to be affected seriously by any interest rate hike in the U.S next week. The Federal Open Market Committee is meeting on Tuesday to discuss rate hike.
"Much of the ringgit's rise was on account of cross-play against the Singapore dollar," one dealer said.
At 0830 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4780/90 a dollar and 1.7137/56 a Singapore dollar.
